research_notes: The present research architecture treats the automation as disposable execution with GitHub as durable evidence/control state.
This makes invocation lifetime an operational resource to optimize rather than a source of hidden conversational continuity.
A validated cap plus pre-arm lets each invocation consume that resource predictably.
Cold-start successors can then resume from durable state without requiring predecessor memory.
This is consistent with the broader persistent-agent design goal.
The current sample tests one piece of that contract empirically.
